conditions.leftValue: ={{ (() => { const b = $json; const arr = Array.isArray(b) ? b : (b.data || b.messages || b.events || []); if (!Array.isArray(arr)) return false; const looksJson = (t) => { let c = String(t || '').replace(/```json/gi, '').replace(/```/g, '').trim(); const s = c.indexOf('{'); const e = c.lastIndexOf('}'); if (s < 0 || e <= s) return false; try { const o = JSON.parse(c.slice(s, e + 1)); return !!o && typeof o === 'object' && (('topic' in o) || ('text' in o)); } catch (err) { return false; } }; return arr.some(m => { const am = m && m.assistant_message; if (!am) return false; if (looksJson(am.content)) return true; return (am.attachments || []).some(a => a && a.url && (/\.json/i.test(a.url) || /json/i.test(a.content_type || ''))); }); })() }}
